remarks:
Opportunity awaits at 1146 Whitney Ave in Niagara Falls! Priced with its current condition in mind, this property offers an affordable entry point for a buyer or investor ready to take on a rehab and unlock its potential. Located just minutes from one of the wonders of the world and situated within an Airbnb/short-term rental zone, the property offers several possibilities for renovation, resale, long-term rental, or a vacation rental strategy.

For investors looking to make a larger impact, the seller will consider packaging 1146 Whitney Ave with nearby 1306 Whitney Ave (B1714411) and 1301–1305 13th St. (1714409) The opportunity to acquire multiple properties in close proximity could provide an investor with greater control of the immediate neighborhood.

Bring your vision and take advantage of an affordable opportunity in a city that attracts millions of visitors from around the world.

As Is sale, no survey or search will be completed, nor a cross-connection inspection will be completed by the seller.
